timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Tenant admin sounds like the person who can fix everything.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: And break everything. The admin plane controls identity, policy, data access, and recovery.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: MFA, phishing-resistant auth, Privileged Identity Management, and separate admin accounts.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Separate from my normal email account?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes. Daily browsing and global admin should never share the same identity.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What if Conditional Access locks everyone out?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: You maintain break-glass accounts, monitor them heavily, and test them on a schedule.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Do admins need special machines too?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: For high privilege, yes. Use hardened workstations and block unmanaged devices from admin portals.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So admin access is a ceremony?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: A deliberate ceremony with logs, approvals, time limits, and no snacks in production.
